{{Top|leg}}
The '''Shadow creature''' was an energy-based [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] creature.

==Biography==
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the shadow creature traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oblis]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], drawn to the power of the [[Darkstaff]], a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that was located on the world. The creature settled above Oblis and began to meld itself with the atmosphere, where it started to grow larger. The native [[Oblee]] felt threatened by the creature and in an attempt to rid their world of it, they created three focusing [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] to harness the power of the Darkstaff. However, when they fired the weapon at the shadow creature, the creature and the Oblee were thrown out across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and Oblis was destroyed.<ref name="Recursion">{{LivingForce|Belted In: Recursion}}</ref>

Thousands of years later,<ref name="Recursion" /> the creature returned to the Cularin system after sensing the power of the [[Almas Sith fortress]], a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith Temple]] that was constructed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Rivan]]. However, by the time the creature arrived in the system, Rivan had been defeated and the presence of the dark side had waned. The creature took refuge in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]],<ref name="Philosophy">{{LivingForce|Below the Belt: Philosophy}}</ref> which had formed from the remains of Oblis,<ref name="Recursion" /> and entered a slumber. However, it was stirred from its sleep by the construction of the [[Almas Academy]] on [[Almas]] and by the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], an event that was caused by the opening up of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt in circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. The creature began drawing power from passing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and was eventually able to free itself from the asteroid that it lay within.<ref name="Philosophy" />
